title: Successful Stripe payment
description: PaymentIntent created, charge succeeded, PaymentIntent succeeded. Includes embedded customer and card fields that PandaPayLens hides.

title: Stripe: insufficient funds
description: A card_error API response with decline_code insufficient_funds.

title: Stripe: authentication required
description: A PaymentIntent that needs 3D Secure, with the off-session decline that triggered it.

title: Stripe: duplicate webhook delivery
description: The same event delivered twice, with receipt timestamps.

title: Stripe: events arriving out of order
description: payment_intent.succeeded arrives before the events that preceded it.

title: Adyen: successful authorisation
description: A Standard webhook AUTHORISATION with success=true. The reason field with card summary is dropped.

title: Adyen: declined authorisation
description: A Refused payment response and the matching AUTHORISATION webhook (Not enough balance).

title: Adyen: authorisation, capture and refund
description: Modifications linked to the payment through originalReference.

title: Unknown provider error
description: An error from an unsupported source. PandaPayLens explains that it cannot analyze it.

title: Mixed, unrelated transactions
description: Stripe and Adyen events for separate payments, kept apart in separate groups.

title: Adyen: duplicate and conflicting webhooks
description: A repeated AUTHORISATION and a CAPTURE delivered with both success=false and success=true.

title: Adyen: possible duplicate charge
description: Two authorised payments for one merchantReference around an internal error.

title: Stripe: api_error with unknown outcome
description: An error that does not say whether the request took effect.

title: Stripe: state change after success
description: A PaymentIntent reported as processing after it had succeeded.

title: payabl.: authorized order notification
description: A form-encoded order notification for a successful authorization.

title: payabl.: declined, insufficient funds
description: A form-encoded Gateway API response for an issuer decline.

title: payabl.: timeout with unknown outcome
description: A Gateway API response where the result of the request is not known.

title: Checkout.com: declined payment
description: A 201 response with approved=false, decoded from response_code.

title: Checkout.com: capture and refund webhooks
description: Gateway webhooks linked through the pay_ payment id and act_ action ids.

title: PayPal: order completed, capture declined
description: An order with status COMPLETED whose capture was declined. The order status is not the payment outcome.

title: PayPal: INSTRUMENT_DECLINED
description: An Orders v2 error with a details[].issue value.

title: PayPal: order and capture webhooks
description: Webhook events for one order, correlated through related_ids.

title: Mollie: failed payment
description: A payment snapshot with status failed and a failureReason.

title: Mollie: authorized, captured and refunded
description: Payment, capture and refund objects linked by their ids.

title: Mollie: classic webhook (id only)
description: A classic webhook carries only the payment id. PandaPayLens explains what else is needed.

title: Square: declined card payment
description: An error response that includes the FAILED payment.

title: Square: payment and refund webhooks
description: payment.* and refund.* events grouped by payment id.

title: Braintree: processor declined
description: A GraphQL response where the decline is a transaction in data, not an error.

title: Braintree: sale, refund and dispute
description: Transaction snapshots linked by transaction and refund ids, built from status history.

title: Braintree: signed webhook (not decodable)
description: A raw bt_signature/bt_payload webhook. PandaPayLens explains what to paste instead.

title: NETbilling: declined, insufficient funds
description: A form-encoded Direct Mode response; the decline is decoded from the whole authorization message.

title: NETbilling: 3DS challenge pending
description: status_code=T with OFFLINE RECORD: nothing is authorized yet.

title: Verotel: subscription postbacks
description: Initial, rebill and cancel postbacks for one subscription, one per line.

title: Verotel: subscription chargeback
description: A FlexPay chargeback postback linked to its sale.

title: PXP: card refused
description: A Transactions API response decoded from PXP's normalized CRD code.

title: PXP: SPEI payout rejected
description: A bank payout reported as rejected; payouts are kept separate from deposits.

title: Trust Payments: AUTH declined
description: A Webservices JSON response with errorcode 70000; the acquirer reason is not published, and the explanation says so.

title: Trust Payments: recurring payments
description: An initial AUTH and RECUR rebills linked by parenttransactionreference.

title: Trust Payments: gaming payout
description: A payout to a card, kept separate from deposits.

title: Segpay: rebill declined
description: A form-encoded postback for a failed recurring charge.

title: Segpay: Stand-In decline
description: A Stand-In approval followed by a decline that reuses the same ids; not treated as a duplicate.

title: Segpay: PayPal dispute postback
description: A dispute postback linked to the original purchase.

title: CCBill: rebill declined
description: A RenewalFailure webhook: a recurring charge failed and CCBill reports the next retry date.

title: CCBill: webhook as a raw HTTP request
description: The event type is read from the URL query string; the body alone does not carry it.

title: CCBill: Background Post denial
description: A declined sale decoded from CCBill's numbered decline codes.

title: emerchantpay: recurring sale declined
description: A form-encoded Genesis notification for a failed rebill; recurring advice codes decide the retry guidance.

title: emerchantpay: chargeback notification
description: A chargeback event linked to the original transaction by its unique id.

title: emerchantpay: declined XML response
description: A Genesis XML payment_response for a declined authorization, read from XML and decoded like its JSON form.

title: Ecommpay: authorization and capture
description: Gate callbacks for an auth and a capture of one payment.

title: Ecommpay: payout declined
description: A declined payout callback, kept separate from deposits.

title: Paymentwall: subscription renewal failed
description: A type 14 pingback: a recurring charge failed.

title: Paymentwall: Brick payment declined
description: A Brick error decoded from the Brick code table.

title: NMI: declined, insufficient funds
description: A Classic Payment API response decoded from response and response_code.

title: NMI: webhooks for auth, capture and refund
description: Transaction webhooks for one payment in one timeline.

title: MiFinity: payout flow
description: A wallet payout from submission to its final status.

title: MiFinity: deposit refused by risk
description: A wallet deposit callback refused by the risk check.

title: Skrill: payment failed
description: A status_url post with status -2 and a failed_reason_code.

title: Skrill: chargeback status
description: A status -3 post: a chargeback with no link to the original payment.

title: Skrill: pending refund (XML over HTTP)
description: A raw HTTP response from refund.pl with an XML body. A pending refund stays pending, not completed.

title: eZeeWallet: transfer declined
description: A transfer notification with a declined status; the decline reason is shown as provider text.

title: eZeeWallet: payout flow
description: A payout request and its status notifications.

title: AstroPay: withdrawal cancelled
description: A payout cancelled with a documented cancel reason.

title: AstroPay: payment creation timeout
description: An HTTP 408 timeout: the outcome is unknown, so the payment must be checked before any retry.

title: Finrax: underpaid crypto payment
description: A deposited payment where only part of the expected amount arrived; shown as an unknown outcome, not a success.

title: Finrax: blocked deposit and pending refund
description: A blocked deposit whose refund still waits for an address.

title: Inpay: payout rejected
description: A payout webhook rejected for a wrong account number, with the request id used to detect repeated deliveries.

title: Inpay: pay-by-bank order cancelled
description: An open banking payment cancelled by the payer.

title: DECTA: hold, capture and refund
description: One order moving from a hold to a capture and a refund.

title: DECTA: payment failure webhook
description: An order.payment_failure webhook with a raw acquirer code decoded as insufficient funds.

title: Trustly: payout failed
description: A payout accepted, then reported as failed, then the amount credited back.

title: Trustly: North America payment failed
description: A Failed event posted as an HTTP request and decoded as insufficient funds.

title: Worldpay: card payment webhooks
description: Access Worldpay events from authorization to settlement in one timeline.

title: Worldpay: refusal with a raw scheme code
description: A Card Payments v7 refusal where the raw scheme code and the Worldpay code are shown side by side.

title: Cybersource: authorization, capture and refund
description: Three operations linked into one timeline through the Transaction Details root id.

title: Cybersource: declined, insufficient funds
description: An HTTP 201 decline decoded with Cybersource's retry advice.

title: Authorize.net: capture and refund
description: Authorization and capture webhooks, the refund response and the refund webhook in one transaction.

title: Authorize.net: card declined
description: The transaction reason code decoded separately from the response code, with AVS and card code results.

title: Nuvei: APM payment pending, then approved
description: Two payment DMNs for one transaction, shown as one timeline.

title: Nuvei: declined, do not honor
description: A REST decline where the Mastercard advice code tightens the retry advice.

title: Paysafe: card declined with merchant advice
description: An HTTP 402 decline with a merchant advice code, an ISO response code and a raw processor code.

title: Paysafe: EPS payment webhooks
description: A payment handle and its payment linked into one timeline.

title: Airwallex: card payment webhooks
description: From creation through authorization, capture and settlement to a partial refund.

title: Airwallex: payment declined by the issuer
description: A PaymentIntent whose latest attempt failed, decoded with the card brand, AVS and CVC results.

title: Rapyd: payment failed webhook
description: A card decline that requires 3DS, with a merchant advice code.

title: Rapyd: payout returned
description: A payout created, completed and then returned, kept separate from payments.

title: dLocal: one code, three meanings
description: The same status_code read for a payment, a chargeback and a payout.

title: dLocal: cash voucher expired
description: An OXXO voucher that stays pending until it expires.

title: EBANX: authorization, capture and refund
description: A card payment authorized, captured and partially refunded in one timeline.

title: EBANX: card declined, insufficient funds
description: A decline inside a successful envelope, with ISO and Mastercard advice codes.

title: BlueSnap: charge, refund and chargeback webhooks
description: Form-encoded webhooks linked into one transaction by the reference number.

title: BlueSnap: declined, do not honor
description: An HTTP 400 decline decoded by error name, although many card errors share one numeric code.

title: PayU India: card declined webhook
description: A declined card payment with the failure stage and the bank's own reason.

title: PayU India: UPI payment pending
description: A UPI payment that is still pending at redirect.

title: Razorpay: card payment webhooks
description: Authorized, captured, order paid and a partial refund in one timeline.

title: Razorpay: late authorisation
description: A UPI payment that fails on timeout and is later authorized and captured.

title: Paystack: card payment with PIN and OTP
description: Initialize, Charge API steps, the charge.success webhook and verify in one payment.

title: Paystack: declined, do not honour
description: A failed verify response decoded from Paystack's documented bank messages.

title: Flutterwave: refund initiated, then completed
description: A refund reported as completed that is only initiated until the refund webhook confirms it.

title: Flutterwave: preauthorization voided
description: A held payment that is voided; the void is not shown as a payment success.
